title: Christmas Shipping Deadlines From Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Outside Europe:** cards and letters by **Wednesday 25 November**, parcels by **Thursday 26 November**.
**Rest of Europe:** cards by **9 December**, parcels by **14 December**, to neighbouring countries by **17 December**.
**Inside Germany:** cards, letters and parcels by **Monday 21 December**, registered letters and DHL Express by 22 December.
**DHL Express abroad:** Europe until **22 December**, the rest of the world until **18 December**.
**Outside the EU** (UK, Switzerland, Norway, Turkey and beyond): a customs form is needed; frank online and it is filled in for you.
**United States:** gifts by post only up to **100 US dollars (85 euros)** a parcel, declared as a gift; more goes by Express.
**My move:** post everything that leaves Europe before Thursday 26 November, then Europe in early December.
